constraints: On Windows, the rendering theme can be set at application and/or form level (inherited or explicit) and also depends on the availability of specific Microsoft libraries at runtime.

On macOS 26 Tahoe and later (as of 4D/4D Server 21 R3), the Liquid Glass interface is used automatically and cannot be disabled, except transitionally in engine-based applications via Apple's UIDesignRequiresCompatibility Info.plist key.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the OS interface rendering theme actually used by the current form ("Classic"/"FluentUI" on Windows, "Classic"/"LiquidGlass" on macOS), or an empty string if there is no current form.
